title: Primex Wireless Time Sync
short: Primex Wireless Time Sync is a VHF Time Synchronization signal used in Primex Wireless's XR Series.
desc: **Primex Wireless Time Sync** is a VHF Time Synchronization signal used in Primex Wireless's XR Series. Has data rate of 2 KBps. Uses BPSK modulation (possible Offset mode).
